description: Diagnose exit 125 without mistaking an ancestor metadata warning for a globally unusable sandbox.
turns: A previous process_run of dotnet --version returned exitCode 125 with stderr: "ai-sandbox: cannot grant metadata access to D:\\: Access is denied. ai-sandbox: Attempted to perform an unauthorized operation." Diagnose this CLI startup failure. That log does not identify the fatal path. Check the currently granted workspace {workspace} with a harmless sandboxed cmd.exe command ["/d","/c","echo CLI_EVAL_LAUNCH_PROBE_OK"]. Do not add any directory grants or use an unrestricted runner. Distinguish the metadata warning from the fatal launch error, and report what the probe actually establishes.
